# pangolin_ai_provider (Resource)

Manages an AI provider of the organization (Pangolin 1.22+): the upstream LLM API an `inference` resource routes to. Attach it with `ai_provider_ids` on `pangolin_resource` or `pangolin_site_resource`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Hosted provider: the upstream URL and API key of the vendor.
resource "pangolin_ai_provider" "openai" {
  name         = "openai"
  type         = "openai"
  upstream_url = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
  api_key      = var.openai_api_key
}

# Self-hosted, OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, vLLM...) without auth.
resource "pangolin_ai_provider" "ollama" {
  name         = "ollama"
  type         = "custom"
  upstream_url = "http://10.0.0.20:11434/v1"
  auth_type    = "none"
  capabilities = ["openai_chat", "v1_models"]
}

# Expose both through an inference resource.
resource "pangolin_resource" "llm" {
  name            = "llm-gateway"
  mode            = "inference"
  subdomain       = "llm"
  domain_id       = data.pangolin_domains.all.domains[0].domain_id
  ai_provider_ids = [pangolin_ai_provider.openai.id, pangolin_ai_provider.ollama.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The provider name.
- `type` (String) The provider type: `openai`, `anthropic`, `googleGemini`, `vertexAi`, `bedrock`, `microsoftFoundry`, `openRouter`, `vercelAiGateway` or `custom`. Changing it replaces the provider.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The upstream API key. Not needed when `auth_type` is `none` or `passthrough`.
- `auth_type` (String) How the API key is sent upstream: `bearer`, `x-api-key`, `x-goog-api-key`, `hec`, `cf-aig-authorization`, `none` or `passthrough`. Defaults to the provider type's usual scheme.
- `capabilities` (Set of String) The API routes the provider serves: `openai_chat`, `openai_responses`, `anthropic_messages`, `v1_models`, `gemini_generate_content`, `bedrock_model_invoke`, `google_generate_content`, `google_raw_predict`, `bedrock_converse`. Required for `custom` providers; other types default to their own.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `headers` (Attributes List, Sensitive) Extra headers sent upstream - list of `{name, value}` objects. Stored encrypted by the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `routing_mode` (String) `url` sends requests to `upstream_url`; `target` (custom providers only) routes them to site targets, declared with `pangolin_target` and `ai_provider_id`. A provider in `target` mode without an enabled, reachable target fails every request (HTTP 500). Defaults to `url`.
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification of the upstream. Defaults to `false`.
- `upstream_url` (String) The upstream API base URL, e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1`. Required unless `routing_mode = "target"`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric provider ID.
- `nice_id` (String) The provider's readable ID, generated by the server.

<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Required:

- `name` (String) Header name.
- `value` (String) Header value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an AI provider by its numeric ID.
terraform import pangolin_ai_provider.openai <provider_id>
```
